content: घट्टः [घट्ट्-घञ्] .²1 A landing place, steps on the side of a river leading to the waters (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>घाट</ns>); श्रीवत्सराजघट्टोऽयं नूनं तेनात्र कारितः . ब्रह्माण्डमुज्ज्वलां कीर्तिमारोहयितुमात्मनः .. <ls>Deogaḍh Rock Inscription of Kīrtivarman, V. 7; Ind. Ant. Vol. XVIII pp. 238-9</ls>. .²2 Stirring, agitating. .²3 A toll station.
